newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chubu Electric to cut time for nuclear plant check.
newsitem.headline: Chubu Electric to cut time for nuclear plant check.

text.p: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc said on Tuesday it hopes to reduce the number of days spent on maintenance checks on its nuclear power plant in a step to raise the plant's operation rate and help cut costs.
A company spokesman said that until recently about 80 to 90 days were spent on annual maintenance checks at each of the four units at its sole nuclear facility.

It hopes to trim this to about 40 to 45 days in the year starting next April 1. Chubu Electric started trying to shorten the maintenance time from April last year. The shortest period so far is 49 days.
An increase in the operation rate of nuclear facilities generally means less reliance on relatively more expensive thermal energy.
The spokesman said figures in fiscal 1995 showed that a one percent increase in the rate of operation of nuclear plants helped cut costs by 700 million yen.
